collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — GOOD, BAD AND ORDINARY DAYS (DAY-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Wonderful days, rotten days, mixed days and days when nothing much happens at all. Moods come without reasons, small things matter more than they should, and nobody has to end the day happier, wiser or more productive than they started it.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult)

collection.description: After a big wind there is sand in absolutely everything a villager owns: give up on the sand, or clean everything.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: There was a big wind last night, and today there is sand in everything. Sand in the water jar. Sand in the sleeping mat. Sand in the fish, the fruit and, somehow, the inside of (subject)'s ear. (subject.He/she) has shaken out the mat three times. There is still sand in it. (friend) wanders by, crunching gently.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) decides that today is simply a sandy day, and there is nothing to be done about it. (subject.He/she) eats the crunchy fish. (subject.He/she) sleeps on the crunchy mat. (subject.He/she) is mildly annoyed the whole time, but no more than mildly. By the next day, the sand has mostly gone. Mostly.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: (subject) takes everything outside, shakes it, washes it, dries it and brings it back. It takes all day. The hut is perfect. That night, the wind gets up again. (subject) lies in the dark listening to it, feeling the first grains settle on (subject.his/her) blanket, and laughs out loud, because what else can you do.
